paper_title: Frequency Ratio Measurements with 18-digit Accuracy Using a Network of Optical Clocks
notes: This is the BACON collaboration paper reporting Al+/Yb, Al+/Sr, and Yb/Sr optical clock frequency ratio measurements with 8e-18 level uncertainty. It is a pure metrology paper: no dark matter search, no exclusion limit, and no coupling constraint is derived. Tests of fundamental physics (e.g., variation of fundamental constants / ultralight dark matter searches, which would map to ScalarPhoton/ScalarElectron) are mentioned only as future applications. The pre-analysis hint of ScalarPhoton likely stems from later papers that use these clock ratios; this paper itself contains no extractable limit data. | Coupling from pre-classifier (ScalarPhoton, conf=0.70)
